```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Clean ---------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

# Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------
# region Libraries_and_settings
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(did)
library(knitr)

options(knitr.table.format = "latex")

# Design: CS-DiD on graduating classes (school x 9th-grade entry cohort), the
# regional 9th-grade door as onset, never-treated = private-paid schools only.
# Inference is region-clustered; stars read off the normal (16 regions).
anticipation <- 2
biters <- 10000
seed <- 20260610
gate_df <- 15 # 16 regions - 1, for the conservative cluster-t robustness

start_year <- 2010
end_year <- 2024
entry_min <- 2012
entry_max <- 2021

media <- c(310, 410, 510, 610, 710, 810) # secondary tracks
hs <- 1:4

outcomes <- c(
  gpa_secondary  = "GPA",
  prom_lm_actual = "Average LM",
  applied        = "Applied",
  assigned       = "Assigned",
  enrolled       = "Enrolled"
)
# endregion
```

```{r functions_to_estimate, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# region estimation_helpers

# One att_gt fit for one outcome. `cluster` is "region" (headline) or "id" (school).
# Returns the model plus BOTH aggregations, computed here on purpose: aggte's
# bootstrap draws its multipliers from the RNG state att_gt leaves behind, so
# the sequence seed -> att_gt -> aggte(simple) -> aggte(dynamic) must run as a
# unit per outcome. Aggregating later (or reordering the two calls) leaves the
# point estimates untouched but changes the bootstrap standard errors.
fit_did <- function(dfc, y, cluster = "region") {
  dd <- data.frame(
    id = as.numeric(dfc$rbd),
    tt = as.numeric(dfc$year),
    G = as.numeric(dfc$gC2),
    region = as.numeric(dfc$region),
    num_students = as.numeric(dfc$num_students),
    yy = as.numeric(dfc[[y]])
  )

  set.seed(seed)
  m <- att_gt(
    yname = "yy",
    tname = "tt",
    idname = "id",
    gname = "G",
    xformla = ~num_students,
    data = dd,
    control_group = "notyettreated",
    anticipation = anticipation,
    base_period = "universal",
    allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE,
    est_method = "dr",
    clustervars = cluster,
    panel = TRUE,
    bstrap = TRUE,
    biters = biters,
    cband = TRUE
  )

  list(
    model = m,
    simple = suppressWarnings(aggte(m, type = "simple", na.rm = TRUE)),
    dynamic = tryCatch(suppressWarnings(aggte(m, type = "dynamic", na.rm = TRUE)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  )
}

# Collapse the per-student base to the class (school x cohort) panel the DiD is
# fit on. year is the process clock: 9th-grade entry minus one.
collapse_coh <- function(base, cols = names(outcomes)) {
  coh <- base[, c(.(num_students = .N), lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = .(rbd, AGNO_9th), .SDcols = cols
  ]
  coh[, year := AGNO_9th - 1L]
  coh <- merge(coh, sch[, .(rbd, gC2, depe, region)], by = "rbd", all.x = TRUE)

  # a door beyond the panel is not observed as treated
  coh[gC2 > max(year), gC2 := 0]
  coh[]
}

# Baseline for the "% effect among the treated" row: treated classes' own pre-period.
pre_mean <- function(coh, y) coh[gC2 > 0 & year < gC2, mean(get(y), na.rm = TRUE)]

# Between-school split (vulnerability, value-added): treated schools are sorted
# Low/High by a school-level index `idx` (data.table: rbd, v) relative to the
# within-region median computed over treated schools; treated schools with a
# missing index are dropped (neither arm). Never-treated private-paid schools
# (gC2 == 0) are the COMMON control in both arms, so the two arms sum back to
# the headline. Class means stay the full-class means: the split only
# reassigns schools, so `coh` (= coh_all) is reused, not re-collapsed.
split_arms <- function(coh, idx) {
  s <- unique(coh[, .(rbd = as.numeric(rbd), region, gC2)])
  s <- merge(s, idx, by = "rbd", all.x = TRUE)
  med <- s[gC2 > 0 & !is.na(v), .(med = median(v)), by = region]
  s <- merge(s, med, by = "region", all.x = TRUE)
  s[, low := as.integer(gC2 > 0 & !is.na(v) & !is.na(med) & v < med)]
  s[, high := as.integer(gC2 > 0 & !is.na(v) & !is.na(med) & v >= med)]

  # split integrity: low/high partition the treated-with-index schools,
  # never overlap, and both arms span more than one region
  stopifnot(
    s[low == 1L & high == 1L, .N] == 0L,
    s[low == 1L, .N] + s[high == 1L, .N] == s[gC2 > 0 & !is.na(v), .N],
    s[low == 1L | gC2 == 0, uniqueN(region)] > 1L,
    s[high == 1L | gC2 == 0, uniqueN(region)] > 1L
  )

  cc <- merge(coh, s[, .(rbd, low, high)], by = "rbd", all.x = TRUE)
  cc[is.na(low), low := 0L]
  cc[is.na(high), high := 0L]
  list(low = cc[gC2 == 0 | low == 1L], high = cc[gC2 == 0 | high == 1L])
}
# endregion
```

```{r functions_to_tabulate, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# region make_did_table
make_did_table <- function(models,
                           caption = "Regression Results",
                           label = "tab: main results",
                           digits = 3,
                           means_pre = NULL,
                           obs = NULL) {
  # Helper: significance stars off the normal (region-clustered SE)
  star_fun <- function(att, se) {
    pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(att / se))
    ifelse(pval < 0.01, "$^{***}$",
      ifelse(pval < 0.05, "$^{**}$",
        ifelse(pval < 0.10, "$^{*}$", "")
      )
    )
  }

  aggs <- lapply(models, function(m) m$simple)
  atts <- sapply(aggs, function(x) x$overall.att)
  ses <- sapply(aggs, function(x) x$overall.se)

  stars <- mapply(star_fun, atts, ses)
  att_fmt <- sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%s"), atts, stars)
  se_fmt <- sprintf(paste0("(%.", digits, "f)"), ses)

  k <- length(models)
  col_header <- paste(names(models), collapse = " & ")
  col_numbers <- paste0("(", 1:k, ")", collapse = " & ")
  att_row <- paste(att_fmt, collapse = " & ")
  se_row <- paste(se_fmt, collapse = " & ")
  means_row <- paste(sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), means_pre), collapse = " & ")
  obs_row <- paste(format(obs, big.mark = ","), collapse = " & ")

  paste0(
    "\\begin{table}[htbp]\n",
    "   \\caption{", caption, "}\\label{", label, "}\n",
    "   \\centerline{\\scalebox{0.85}{\\begin{tabular}{l", strrep("c", k), "}\n",
    "      \\toprule\n",
    "                   & ", col_header, "\\\\\n",
    "                   & ", col_numbers, "\\\\\n",
    "      \\midrule\n",
    "      Treated & ", att_row, "\\\\\n",
    "       & ", se_row, "\\\\\n",
    "      \\midrule\n",
    "      Mean (pre-treatment) & ", means_row, "\\\\\n",
    "      Observations & ", obs_row, "\\\\\n",
    "      \\bottomrule\n",
    "   \\end{tabular}}}\n",
    "\\end{table}\n"
  )
}
# endregion

# region make_did_pair_table
# Two-arm layout for the heterogeneity tables (Female|Male, Low|High): one
# 2-column group per outcome, sub-labels repeated under each group. Rows are
# the same simple-ATT rows as make_did_table, with stars off the normal.
make_did_pair_table <- function(models_a, models_b,
                                sub_labels,
                                caption = "Regression Results",
                                label = "tab: het results",
                                digits = 3,
                                means_pre_a = NULL,
                                means_pre_b = NULL,
                                obs_a = NULL,
                                obs_b = NULL) {
  star_fun <- function(att, se) {
    pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(att / se))
    ifelse(pval < 0.01, "$^{***}$",
      ifelse(pval < 0.05, "$^{**}$",
        ifelse(pval < 0.10, "$^{*}$", "")
      )
    )
  }
  simple <- function(models) {
    aggs <- lapply(models, function(m) m$simple)
    atts <- sapply(aggs, function(x) x$overall.att)
    ses <- sapply(aggs, function(x) x$overall.se)
    list(
      att = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%s"), atts, mapply(star_fun, atts, ses)),
      se = sprintf(paste0("(%.", digits, "f)"), ses)
    )
  }
  a <- simple(models_a)
  b <- simple(models_b)

  k <- length(models_a)
  interleave <- function(x, y) as.vector(rbind(x, y)) # a1 b1 a2 b2 ...
  fmt <- function(x) sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x)
  est_row <- paste(interleave(a$att, b$att), collapse = " & ")
  se_row <- paste(interleave(a$se, b$se), collapse = " & ")
  pre_row <- paste(interleave(fmt(means_pre_a), fmt(means_pre_b)), collapse = " & ")
  obs_row <- paste(
    rep(c(format(obs_a, big.mark = ","), format(obs_b, big.mark = ",")), k),
    collapse = " & "
  )

  groups <- paste0("      & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{", names(models_a), "}", collapse = "\n")
  cmid <- paste0("\\cmidrule(lr){", seq(2, 2 * k, 2), "-", seq(3, 2 * k + 1, 2), "}", collapse = "")
  sub <- paste(rep(paste(sub_labels[1], "&", sub_labels[2]), k), collapse = "& ")
  col_numbers <- paste0("(", 1:(2 * k), ")", collapse = " & ")

  paste0(
    "\\begin{table}[htp!]\n",
    "   \\caption{", caption, "}\\label{", label, "}\n",
    "   \\centerline{\\scalebox{0.85}{\n",
    "   \\begin{tabular}{l", strrep("c", 2 * k), "}\n",
    "      \\toprule\n",
    groups, " \\\\\n",
    "      ", cmid, "\n",
    "                   & ", sub, " \\\\\n",
    "                   & ", col_numbers, "\\\\\n",
    "      \\midrule\n",
    "      Treated & ", est_row, "\\\\\n",
    "       & ", se_row, "\\\\\n",
    "                   \\midrule\n",
    "      Mean pre-treatment & ", pre_row, "\\\\\n",
    "      Observations & ", obs_row, "\\\\\n",
    "      \\bottomrule\n",
    "   \\end{tabular}   \n",
    "   }}\n\n",
    "\\end{table}\n"
  )
}
# endregion

# region make_eventstudy_table
# Bold marks significance at the 95% uniform band (multiplier bootstrap, region).
# Display clock: the anticipation band (calendar -2, -1) and the base (-3) are
# set aside, so displayed event time -k is the k-th clean cohort before the
# reference (calendar -3-k); post periods are calendar event time.
make_eventstudy_table <- function(models,
                                  caption = "Event-Study Estimates",
                                  label = "tab: parallel trends assumption",
                                  digits = 3,
                                  display = data.frame(
                                    disp = c(-5:-1, 0:4),
                                    cal = c(-8:-4, 0:4)
                                  )) {
  dyn <- lapply(models, function(m) m$dynamic)

  body <- ""
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(display))) {
    att_cells <- character(0)
    se_cells <- character(0)

    for (d in dyn) {
      j <- which(d$egt == display$cal[i])
      stopifnot(length(j) == 1L) # every model must carry the full display grid
      att <- d$att.egt[j]
      se <- d$se.egt[j]
      uniform_sig <- isTRUE(abs(att) > d$crit.val.egt * se) # crit.val.egt is one scalar per model

      cell <- sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), att)
      att_cells <- c(att_cells, if (uniform_sig) paste0("\\textbf{", cell, "}") else cell)
      se_cells <- c(se_cells, sprintf(paste0("(%.", digits, "f)"), se))
    }

    body <- paste0(
      body,
      "      Event time ", display$disp[i], " & ", paste(att_cells, collapse = " & "), "\\\\\n",
      "       & ", paste(se_cells, collapse = " & "), "\\\\\n"
    )
  }

  k <- length(models)
  paste0(
    "\\begin{table}[htbp]\n",
    "   \\caption{", caption, "}\\label{", label, "}\n",
    "   \\centerline{\\scalebox{0.85}{\\begin{tabular}{l", strrep("c", k), "}\n",
    "      \\toprule\n",
    "                   & ", paste(names(models), collapse = " & "), "\\\\\n",
    "                   & ", paste0("(", 1:k, ")", collapse = " & "), "\\\\\n",
    "      \\midrule\n",
    body,
    "      \\bottomrule\n",
    "   \\end{tabular}}}\n",
    "\\end{table}\n"
  )
}
# endregion
```

```{r sample_selection, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# --- Step 1: read the panel and drop columns we don't need ---
# This shrinks memory BEFORE any subset copy.
df <- readRDS("data/panel_9-12_2010_2021.rds")
setDT(df)

keep_cols <- c(
  "MRUN", "AGNO", "RBD", "GEN_ALU", "COD_GRADO", "COD_ENSE",
  "COD_REG_RBD", "COD_DEPE",
  "year_rbd_first_sae", "graduated_secondary",
  names(outcomes)
)
keep_cols <- intersect(keep_cols, names(df))
drop_cols <- setdiff(names(df), keep_cols)
if (length(drop_cols) > 0L) df[, (drop_cols) := NULL]
rm(drop_cols, keep_cols)
gc()

# --- Step 2: the school / door table ---
# The door is REGIONAL: a school's onset is the first year any school in its
# region opened 9th grade under SAE. Never-treated = private-paid (COD_DEPE 4).
# One row per school off the unique 4-column projection: first non-NA region,
# MODAL dependency. The row multiplicities feeding the modal matter: adding
# columns to the unique() flips borderline schools' depe, which moves schools
# in/out of the never-treated control group and every ATT with it.
sch <- unique(df[, .(RBD, year_rbd_first_sae, COD_REG_RBD, COD_DEPE)])[, .(
  yfs    = { v <- year_rbd_first_sae[!is.na(year_rbd_first_sae)]; if (length(v)) as.numeric(v[1L]) else 0 },
  region = { v <- COD_REG_RBD[!is.na(COD_REG_RBD)]; if (length(v)) as.integer(v[1L]) else NA_integer_ },
  depe   = { v <- COD_DEPE[!is.na(COD_DEPE)]; if (length(v)) as.integer(names(which.max(table(v)))) else NA_integer_ }
), by = .(rbd = RBD)]

sae <- readRDS("data/sae_data_2016_2023.rds")
setDT(sae)

# first year each school appears with a 9th grade under SAE, then the region's minimum
nine <- sae[COD_ENSE %in% media & COD_GRADO == 1L, .(g9 = as.numeric(min(AGNO))), by = .(rbd = RBD)]
sch <- merge(sch, nine, by = "rbd", all.x = TRUE)
sch <- merge(sch, sch[!is.na(g9) & !is.na(region), .(g9r = min(g9)), by = region],
  by = "region", all.x = TRUE
)

# unknown dependency falls back to "eligible if it ever ran SAE"
sch[, elig := fifelse(!is.na(depe), as.integer(depe != 4L), as.integer(yfs > 0 | !is.na(g9)))]
sch[, gC2 := fifelse(elig == 1L & !is.na(g9r), as.numeric(g9r), 0)]
rm(sae, nine)
gc()

# --- Step 3: the per-student base ---
# Any-track: keep students whose whole record is primary (110) or a regular
# secondary track. Then keep the 4-year same-school stayers, anchored on 9th grade.
any_track <- df[, .(only_regular = all(COD_ENSE == 110L | COD_ENSE %in% media)), by = MRUN]
reg_any <- any_track[only_regular == TRUE, MRUN]

hs0 <- df[
  MRUN %in% reg_any & AGNO >= start_year & AGNO <= end_year &
    COD_ENSE %in% media & COD_GRADO %in% hs,
  .(MRUN, AGNO, RBD, COD_GRADO)
]
setorder(hs0, MRUN, AGNO, COD_GRADO)

# the 9th-grade school and entry year define the class a student belongs to
anchor <- hs0[COD_GRADO == 1L, .(rbd = RBD[1L], AGNO_9th = AGNO[1L]), by = MRUN]
hs0 <- merge(hs0, anchor[, .(MRUN, rbd)], by = "MRUN")

per <- hs0[, .(ng = uniqueN(COD_GRADO[RBD == rbd]), nsch = uniqueN(RBD)), by = MRUN]
per <- merge(per, anchor, by = "MRUN")
stayers <- per[ng == 4L & nsch == 1L, .(MRUN, rbd, AGNO_9th)]

grad_year <- hs0[MRUN %in% stayers$MRUN, .(grad_year = max(AGNO)), by = MRUN]

# outcomes and gender are per-student constants: take the first non-NA
student <- df[
  MRUN %in% stayers$MRUN,
  lapply(.SD, function(x) {
    v <- x[!is.na(x)]
    if (length(v)) as.numeric(v[1L]) else NA_real_
  }),
  by = MRUN,
  .SDcols = c(names(outcomes), "graduated_secondary", "GEN_ALU")
]

base <- merge(stayers, student, by = "MRUN")
base <- merge(base, grad_year, by = "MRUN")
base <- base[graduated_secondary == 1]
base <- base[grad_year == AGNO_9th + 3L] # on-time graduation
base <- base[AGNO_9th >= entry_min & AGNO_9th <= entry_max]

rm(df, any_track, hs0, anchor, per, stayers, grad_year, student)
gc()

# --- Step 4: the class-level panel every table is fit on ---
coh_all <- collapse_coh(base)
```

# Headline

```{r headline_estimation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
models <- map(names(outcomes), ~ fit_did(coh_all, .x, cluster = "region"))
names(models) <- unname(outcomes)

means_pre <- map_dbl(names(outcomes), ~ pre_mean(coh_all, .x))
obs <- rep(nrow(coh_all), length(outcomes))
```

```{r headline_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
out <- make_did_table(
  models,
  caption = " Regression Results",
  label = "tab: main results",
  means_pre = means_pre,
  obs = obs
)
writeLines(out, "tables/staggered_did_sae_on_outcomes_AM.tex")
cat(out)
```

## Parallel trends

```{r event_study_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
out <- make_eventstudy_table(
  models,
  caption = paste0(
    "Event-Study Estimates (Panel A), REGION-clustered inference. Dynamic ATT from CS-DiD, anticipation = 2, ",
    "universal base; all regular secondary tracks. Displayed event time $-k$ is the $k$-th clean cohort before the ",
    "reference (calendar $-3-k$); the anticipation band (calendar $-2$ to $-1$) is set aside. Bold: significant at the ",
    "95\\% uniform confidence band computed from a multiplier bootstrap clustered at the region level (16 regions). ",
    "Region-clustered standard errors in parentheses. A pre-treatment cell in bold indicates a joint pre-trend ",
    "violation at the region-clustered uniform band. Event time $+4$ is identified by Magallanes only."
  ),
  label = "tab: parallel trends assumption"
)
writeLines(out, "tables/parallel_trends_sae_on_outcomes_AM.tex")
cat(out)
```

# Heterogeneity

## By gender

```{r gender_estimation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Class means recomputed within each sex, so num_students is the subgroup class
# size (GEN_ALU: 2 = female, 1 = male; unknown-sex students are dropped).
female <- base[GEN_ALU == 2]
male <- base[GEN_ALU == 1]

# split integrity: female/male/unknown partition the base, and F != M
# (catches the copy-paste bug where both panels filter the same sex)
stopifnot(
  nrow(female) + nrow(male) + base[is.na(GEN_ALU) | GEN_ALU == 0, .N] == nrow(base),
  nrow(female) != nrow(male)
)

coh_f <- collapse_coh(female)
coh_m <- collapse_coh(male)

models_f <- map(names(outcomes), ~ fit_did(coh_f, .x, cluster = "region"))
models_m <- map(names(outcomes), ~ fit_did(coh_m, .x, cluster = "region"))
names(models_f) <- names(models_m) <- unname(outcomes)

means_pre_f <- map_dbl(names(outcomes), ~ pre_mean(coh_f, .x))
means_pre_m <- map_dbl(names(outcomes), ~ pre_mean(coh_m, .x))
```

```{r gender_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
out <- make_did_pair_table(
  models_f, models_m,
  sub_labels = c("Female", "Male"),
  caption = paste0(
    "Effect on Outcomes by Gender. Callaway--Sant'Anna staggered DiD on graduating ",
    "classes (school $\\times$ 9th-grade-entry cohort, 2012--2021), all regular ",
    "secondary tracks; class means computed separately over female and male students ",
    "(students with unknown sex are dropped). Anticipation $=2$, universal base ",
    "($e=-3$); doubly robust, with the subgroup class size as control. ",
    "Standard errors clustered at the region level (16 regions, the level of treatment ",
    "assignment); significance from the region-clustered multiplier bootstrap (normal reference). ",
    "$^{*}p<0.1$; $^{**}p<0.05$; $^{***}p<0.01$."
  ),
  label = "tab: did results by gender",
  means_pre_a = means_pre_f, means_pre_b = means_pre_m,
  obs_a = nrow(coh_f), obs_b = nrow(coh_m)
)
writeLines(out, "tables/did_by_gender_AM.tex")
cat(out)
```

## By vulnerability

```{r vulnerability_estimation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Between-school split on the 2015 IVE-SINAE vulnerability index (secondary),
# joined at the school; the arms come off split_arms (within-region median over
# treated schools, privates as common control).
ee <- readRDS("data/panel_ee_2004_2025_homogenized.rds")
setDT(ee)
ive15 <- unique(ee[year == 2015L, .(rbd = as.numeric(rbd), v = as.numeric(ive_sinae_media))])
ive15 <- ive15[!is.na(rbd)]
rm(ee)
gc()

arms_v <- split_arms(coh_all, ive15)

models_vl <- map(names(outcomes), ~ fit_did(arms_v$low, .x, cluster = "region"))
models_vh <- map(names(outcomes), ~ fit_did(arms_v$high, .x, cluster = "region"))
names(models_vl) <- names(models_vh) <- unname(outcomes)

means_pre_vl <- map_dbl(names(outcomes), ~ pre_mean(arms_v$low, .x))
means_pre_vh <- map_dbl(names(outcomes), ~ pre_mean(arms_v$high, .x))
```

```{r vulnerability_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
out <- make_did_pair_table(
  models_vl, models_vh,
  sub_labels = c("Low", "High"),
  caption = paste0(
    "Effect on Outcomes by Vulnerability. Callaway--Sant'Anna staggered DiD on graduating ",
    "classes (school $\\times$ 9th-grade-entry cohort, 2012--2021), all regular secondary ",
    "tracks. A between-school split: treated schools are sorted into Low/High vulnerability ",
    "by the 2015 IVE-SINAE index relative to the within-region median computed over treated ",
    "schools; treated schools with a missing index are dropped. Never-treated private-paid ",
    "schools serve as the common control in both columns. Class means use the full class size ",
    "as control. Anticipation $=2$, universal base ($e=-3$); doubly robust. ",
    "Standard errors clustered at the region level (16 regions, the level of treatment ",
    "assignment); significance from the region-clustered multiplier bootstrap (normal reference). ",
    "$^{*}p<0.1$; $^{**}p<0.05$; $^{***}p<0.01$."
  ),
  label = "tab: did by vulnerability",
  means_pre_a = means_pre_vl, means_pre_b = means_pre_vh,
  obs_a = nrow(arms_v$low), obs_b = nrow(arms_v$high)
)
writeLines(out, "tables/did_by_vulnerability_AM.tex")
cat(out)
```

## By school value-added

```{r value_added_estimation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Same machinery with the split variable swapped: the 2016 SES-adjusted growth
# value-added (the school fixed effect from a regression of standardized
# 10th-grade mathematics on standardized 8th-grade mathematics and reading,
# student sex, mother's education, household income, prior grade repetition,
# and residential-commune fixed effects).
va <- fread("data/va_2016_gazmuri.csv")
va <- va[!is.na(rbd) & !is.na(va), .(rbd = as.numeric(rbd), v = as.numeric(va))]

arms_va <- split_arms(coh_all, va)

models_val <- map(names(outcomes), ~ fit_did(arms_va$low, .x, cluster = "region"))
models_vah <- map(names(outcomes), ~ fit_did(arms_va$high, .x, cluster = "region"))
names(models_val) <- names(models_vah) <- unname(outcomes)

means_pre_val <- map_dbl(names(outcomes), ~ pre_mean(arms_va$low, .x))
means_pre_vah <- map_dbl(names(outcomes), ~ pre_mean(arms_va$high, .x))
```

```{r value_added_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
out <- make_did_pair_table(
  models_val, models_vah,
  sub_labels = c("Low", "High"),
  caption = paste0(
    "Effect on Outcomes by School Value-Added. Callaway--Sant'Anna staggered DiD on graduating ",
    "classes (school $\\times$ 9th-grade-entry cohort, 2012--2021), all regular secondary tracks. ",
    "A between-school split: treated schools are sorted into Low/High value-added by a 2016 ",
    "SES-adjusted growth value-added measure (the school fixed effect from a regression of ",
    "standardized 10th-grade mathematics on standardized 8th-grade mathematics and reading, ",
    "student sex, mother's education, household income, prior grade repetition, and ",
    "residential-commune fixed effects) relative to the within-region median computed over ",
    "treated schools; treated schools with a missing measure are dropped. Never-treated ",
    "private-paid schools serve as the common control in both columns. Class means use the full ",
    "class size as control. Anticipation $=2$, universal base ($e=-3$); doubly robust. Standard ",
    "errors clustered at the region level (16 regions, the level of treatment assignment); ",
    "significance from the region-clustered multiplier bootstrap (normal reference). ",
    "$^{*}p<0.1$; $^{**}p<0.05$; $^{***}p<0.01$."
  ),
  label = "tab: did by value added",
  means_pre_a = means_pre_val, means_pre_b = means_pre_vah,
  obs_a = nrow(arms_va$low), obs_b = nrow(arms_va$high)
)
writeLines(out, "tables/did_by_value_added_AM.tex")
cat(out)
```
